name: Zombie Survival
description: Pure flat 2D cartoon survival series aesthetic with locked hero narrator and uniform olive-green zombie horde.
system_instructions:
**Global Visual Foundation:** Pure flat 2D cartoon, rendered in a 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio (1920x1080). Standardized stick-figure aesthetic with clean, flat vector-style fills. Heavy, uniform near-black (#1A1A1A) outlines wrap every character, prop, and background object. Line width remains consistent regardless of depth or scale. Absolutely zero 3D elements, zero volumetric shading, zero soft gradients, zero bevels, zero textures, and zero photorealism. Zero realistic human proportions, zero blood, zero gore, zero dismemberment.

**Main Character ("YOU" / Hero Narrator Lock):** The protagonist ("YOU") must remain 100% visually consistent in every scene where he appears: large round off-white head (#F5F5F0) roughly 1/3 of total body height, two small solid black dot eyes, short flat straight-line mouth, no nose, no ears, with short black hair tufts peeking out along the forehead and behind ears. Wears a backwards flat-red baseball cap (#D63A2A) with a dark curved brim pointing behind the head and a small black strap adjustment button at the front brow. Upper body apparel is a dark charcoal-grey zip-up hoodie (#333333) worn over a solid pure-white t-shirt (#FFFFFF). A dark leather-brown cross-body messenger bag strap (#4A2E1B) runs diagonally across the chest from right shoulder down to left hip. Small silver metallic key clip attached to waistband. Uniformly thin black stick arms and stick legs terminating in simple straight or bent stick ends (no detailed hands, fingers, feet, or shoes).

**The Outbreak Horde (Uniform Zombie Lock):** ALL zombies in every scene MUST look identical in design, color, and silhouette—no different zombie variants, mutations, or mismatched styles: round stick-head with dull pale olive-green skin fill (#8A9A66 / #7A8B58) and sparse wispy black hair tufts sticking upward. Large circular white eyes (#FFFFFF) with tiny centered black dot pupils. Wide open gaping mouths showing sharp jagged white teeth along top and bottom jaws. Oversized tattered dark-brown jackets (#5C4033) with shredded bottom hems, layered over frayed pale-grey or off-white undershirts, and dark grey torn trousers with shredded knee holes. Hunched off-balance postures, thin black stick arms extended straight forward with simplified clawed hands, thin stick legs in slow shuffled lines or dense crowd arrangements. Visual threat is derived strictly from crowd density, unblinking expressions, decaying clothing, and sharp teeth—never graphic blood, gore, or dismemberment.

**Contextual Side Characters (NPCs):** Built on the identical 2D stick-figure foundation (round off-white head, dot eyes, straight-line mouth, stick limbs, thick black outlines) with simple flat attire fitting their role (e.g. businessman in flat navy suit and red tie, store clerk in apron, police in navy uniform with gold badge outline).

**Environment & Atmosphere:** Fully constructed flat vector environments. Supermarkets and warehouses feature sharp 1-point perspective down aisles with rows of flat colored rectangular blocks representing inventory, illuminated by flat white rectangular ceiling fluorescent lights. Exterior night scenes feature dominant dark navy-purple skies (#12182E) with flat architectural silhouettes and warm localized yellow streetlamp light pools. Eye-level wide locked-off framing with crisp perspective.

**STRICTLY AVOID:** 3D rendering, CGI shaders, volumetric lighting, gradients, bevels, photorealism, textures, realistic human faces or anatomy, blood, gore, dismemberment, changing the hero's backwards red cap or hoodie colors, or creating inconsistent or different-looking zombies.
